items.subject: mRNA-4157/V940 Personalized Cancer Vaccine
items.supporting_quote: The compound has demonstrated strong preclinical efficacy and the development team is planning to advance to Phase 3.

items.subject: Fast Track Designation pathway
items.supporting_quote: Fast Track | Expedited review, rolling submission | 3-5 years | Medium | Requires serious condition unmet need

items.subject: Breakthrough Therapy Designation pathway
items.supporting_quote: Breakthrough Therapy | Intensive FDA guidance, cross-functional review | 2-4 years | Medium-High | Strong preliminary clinical evidence required

items.subject: Accelerated Approval pathway
items.supporting_quote: Accelerated Approval | Surrogate endpoint acceptable | 2-3 years | High | Post-market confirmatory study required

items.subject: Regulatory team recommendation
items.statement: Fast Track Designation based on the strength of existing clinical and nonclinical data
items.supporting_quote: The Regulatory team recommends pursuing Fast Track Designation based on the strength of existing clinical and nonclinical data.

items.subject: FDA regulatory engagement
items.statement: Submit Type B meeting request to FDA; Prepare Briefing Document with clinical and nonclinical data package; Engage external regulatory consultants for FDA interaction strategy; Brief Senior Leadership on regulatory pathway recommendation
